title: PalaceTemplateFile
description: content/palace-templates/{slug}.json: a memory palace template (memory-labs flow §5.6, gap G3). Rooms in walk order, each an Agnes sunny-scene image (or a pano-360 scene for kind pano360) with 5 to 10 spots in walk order. The app copies the rooms and spots into a new palace (palace_saved, sync v1.5); the room id travels as template_room.

kind.description: The MEM-13 tile it appears under. Mix your own rooms (custom) strings rooms of these templates together, so it has no template of its own.

exam_profiles.description: Exam profiles this template is offered in (memory-labs matrix 'Templates per exam'). Missing or empty: every profile.

PalaceTemplateId.description: pt. then a slug. Never changes once published: palaces keep it as template_id.

image.description: An image request with preset sunny-scene. Its alt text is the room's description for screen readers.

pano.description: A pano360 request (pano-360 preset), for kind pano360.

order.description: Walk order in the room, 0-based and gapless.

pos.description: {x, y} fractions of the picture for an image room, {yaw, pitch} degrees for a pano room.

label.description: What the spot is in the picture (the door, the clock), read by screen readers and shown in the walk. No text is ever drawn into the image.
